_comment: svg2tgs translation. Strings only: {name} is a placeholder, keep it as is. Check: npm run check-locales.
dropHint: Files or folders. You can also paste SVG code — Ctrl+V.
clearHint: Remove all files from the list
exportHint: Save all files in the list as TGS
toSourceHint: Each TGS is saved next to its SVG
scopeAllHint: Settings below apply to all files without their own settings
scopeOneHint2: Own settings for the selected file only
emojiHint: Custom emoji: shown inside a text line, thin lines nearly vanish
boundsContainerHint: The whole SVG area, with empty margins
boundsContentHint: The frame hugs the drawing on all sides, including its stroke width
scopeOneHint: Settings below apply only to {name}. Other files use the common ones.
fitCoverHint: Fill the square, the excess is cropped
fitWidthHint: Fit width; the excess at the top and bottom is cropped, move with Y
fitHeightHint: Fit height; the excess at the sides is cropped, move with X
precisionHint: Alt or Ctrl — smooth and finer · Shift — in steps (rotation by 15°) · Shift+Alt — finer, step 1. Mouse wheel — over a focused field.
cropHint: Crop and rotate with the mouse in the preview
ownSettingsToast: Edit applied only to {name} — the file now has its own settings
cropHelp: Edges and corners — crop · inside the frame — move · ● — rotate · Alt or Ctrl — finer · Shift — rotate by 15°
viewEmojiHint: Show as an emoji; thin line check
bgClipHint: The drawing and its outline are clipped to the rounded background frame
singleHint: One TGS for the whole drawing
sliceHint: Split the drawing into a grid of emoji — a picture made of several emoji
autoGrid: Fit the grid to the drawing's proportions, up to 8 per row
sliceInfo: {n} emoji · files {first} … {last}, row by row, left to right
sliceWide: More than 8 per row — Telegram will wrap the rows of the picture
sliceResult: As Telegram assembles it · {n} emoji, up to {size}
exportOneTiles: Export only {name} — {n} emoji of the grid
scopeSelectedHint: Edits below apply to {n} selected files. Other files keep their settings.
selectHint: Ctrl — add to selection, Shift — select a range
ownSettingsToastMany: Edit applied only to the {n} selected files — they now have their own settings
warn_filter_removed: “{filter}” effect is not supported in Telegram and was removed
warn_mask_removed: Mask is not supported and was removed
warn_image_removed: Raster image inside the SVG is not supported and was removed
warn_blend_mode_ignored: Blend mode “{mode}” is not supported, normal is used
warn_simplified: Outlines simplified to fit the limit — up to {tolerance} px off out of 512
warn_too_complex: Shape is too complex ({points} points, limit {limit}): Telegram won't draw it
warn_thin_lines_for_emoji: {width} px lines (of 512) will nearly vanish in a text line — use {recommended} px or more
error_invalid_svg: The file is damaged or not an SVG
warn_size_over_limit: File is {size} KB, Telegram allows {limit} KB — simplify the drawing
warn_duration_too_long: Duration is {secs} s, Telegram allows up to {max} s
importHelp: Paste text copied with “Copy”, or JSON for svg2tgs --options. It applies to {target}.
importTargetMany: the settings of the selected files ({n})
importOk: Settings read: {n}, the rest are defaults
importErr_syntax: Cannot read: line {line}, column {column} — this is not JSON
importErr_value: Cannot read: line {line}, column {column} — wrong kind of value
importErr_not_object: Expected an object with settings in curly braces
importErr_newer_format: Settings from a newer svg2tgs — please update
importErr_too_large: The file is too large for settings
gridSize: Grid size: columns, rows follow the proportions
zoomHint: Wheel — zoom · drag — move · double-click — fit
